verdict.summary: PR #282 exports assertPullPolicy and adds an engine-automation admission branch that relaxes only the author-association and linked-execution-issue requirements, gated on exact trusted App actor provenance (normalizeWorkerPullRequestActor(pull.user)) AND a release/ or reconcile/ head-branch prefix. All other admission controls are preserved (open/ready, same-repository head, protected main/dev base, non-protected non-base head, and all stale-target checks). The App actor is GitHub-authoritative and cannot be forged by head-controlled content; the branch prefix is only consequential when combined with that trusted actor, so no trust-boundary violation is introduced. normalizeWorkerPullRequestActor is an unchanged base-trusted primitive already relied upon in this file to authenticate the App's own review-result comments, so its reuse for actor provenance is consistent. The regression triplet correctly proves the positive path (both prefixes admitted without association or linked issue), the negative-actor path (non-App on release/ stays blocked on provenance), and the negative-prefix paths (App on an unowned branch still needs the worker marker and then an execution issue). Change is minimal, cohesive, and maps to linked issue #280; complete review of the current head found no blocking issues.
nonBlockingNotes: Scope is intentionally broader than issue #280 (which describes zero-diff reconcile PRs): the change admits all trusted-App release/ and reconcile/ PRs regardless of diff size. This is documented and justified by observed #279/#281, and non-empty release PR diffs still receive full model review; only the provenance/linked-issue admission gate is relaxed.

Zero-diff reconcile PRs are now admitted but still run the medium+high model rounds rather than being short-circuit auto-approved; issue #280 explicitly allowed either behavior, so this is acceptable.
The branch-prefix regex /^(?:release|reconcile)\// is case-sensitive (no i flag), which is appropriately conservative given the engine authors lowercase prefixes.

Safety depends on normalizeWorkerPullRequestActor denoting exact DarkFactory App provenance rather than generic bot detection; it is an unchanged base-trusted helper (out of this diff's scope) already used for App comment authentication, so it was not re-verified here.
